algorithm: Predictive Sampling: zero-order, derivative-free sampling-based shooting MPC over a spline-parameterised control sequence; the framework (MJPC) also implements iLQG and Gradient Descent as alternative planners, but the Hand result is attributed to Predictive Sampling
headline_metric: total planning time per update (aggregate across the paper's three highlighted examples, not broken out per task)
note_gaps: Appendix B's Hand-task cost block is corrupted by PDF flattening: only 2 of the stated 3 cost terms (cube orientation, cube linear velocity) could be reliably extracted, the third term's residual/weight is lost. The C++ residual implementing the Hand/cube task (shadow_reorient) is absent from the extracted code, so the reward block could not be cross-checked against code. No success/failure criterion, eval-episode count, or numeric success rate is stated for the Hand task.
